lcc_original: 七月十七日、樓船停在亞拉臘【1】山間。
notes: LCC uses 樓船 (lit. 'tower-boat') where UNV uses 方舟 for the ark; H8392 assigned to 樓船
LCC uses 山間 ('among the mountains') where UNV uses 山上 ('atop the mountain'); H2022 attaches to 山, the locative particle 間 is LCC's own phrasing and left unannotated
{<WAH09001>}{<WH02320>} (the closing 'of the month' phrase, לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ) kept implicit since LCC does not repeat 月
Footnote marker 【1】 preserved in its original position between 亞拉臘<WH0780> and 山<WH02022>間
